selection_reasoning: The 'find bookshelf' task is a straightforward observation/navigation task that requires the agent to locate a bookshelf block in the Minecraft environment. It is easily verifiable (the agent must look at or be near a bookshelf), does not require deep Minecraft domain knowledge, and can be set up in a scene with clear visual landmarks. As a single atomic task, no dependency edges are needed.

milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate/observe task. The player must navigate close enough to the bookshelf blocks (center at spawn-relative [8, 1, 3] on the south exterior wall of the oak planks building) and face toward them, confirming visual discovery. max_distance=16 allows detection from a reasonable viewing distance (~8.6 blocks from spawn), and facing_tolerance=60° ensures the player is actively looking at the bookshelves rather than accidentally passing by. The milestone is NOT already satisfied at spawn because the player's default facing direction does not point toward the bookshelf — the player must actively rotate their camera.

scene_description: A flat grass area with a small oak planks library building ~8 blocks east of spawn. The building has 4 bookshelf blocks embedded in its south-facing exterior wall (2 wide × 2 tall), clearly visible without entering. A cobblestone structure sits to the west as a distractor landmark. The terrain is flat grass for easy navigation.
task_text: Find the bookshelf in the scene. Look around and navigate toward the building with bookshelves on its wall.
design_notes: Bookshelves placed on the EXTERIOR south wall (z=3) of the building so they are visible without entering. Building is 5x6 blocks footprint, walls are oak planks, with a door on the north side. Cobblestone structure to the west serves as a visual distractor. Flat grass terrain ensures unobstructed navigation. Player spawns at origin facing roughly north — must turn right/east to spot the building and approach. Milestone uses position_near_with_facing: player is within 16 blocks (spawn is ~8.6 blocks away) but must actively face the bookshelf (facing_tolerance=60°), preventing trivial completion without looking.
